answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The dune explorer shows the whole merge tree. Splitting into 7 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded signal account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
